page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is a storage-focused virtual instance belonging to the Local SSDs family. Powered by the KVM hypervisor on x86_64 architecture, it is provisioned with 52 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The server pairs this compute allocation with 384.0 GB of system RAM, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of memory per core. The configuration includes 11519 GB of integrated local SSD storage, 16 Gbps baseline network throughput, and no GPU accelerators.

Hardware resource distribution prioritizes massive local disk capacity and substantial memory density. Because local SSD capacity is directly bundled, this instance type eliminates network latency for primary storage operations, offering a cost-efficient model for data-heavy configurations that would otherwise require expansive and expensive attached block storage. Tradeoffs include standard baseline network bandwidth capped at 16 Gbps and the operational overhead associated with managing data persistence across ephemeral local SSD storage.

Given its combination of 52 dedicated compute cores, 384.0 GB memory, and over 11 TB of local SSD capacity, ecs.i3.13xlarge fits high-capacity transactional databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, real-time analytics engines, and data warehousing workloads requiring fast local disk access.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is a dedicated compute and local storage instance from the Local SSDs family, running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor at 2.5 GHz. It offers 52 vCPUs, 384.0 GB of memory (7.38 GB per core), and an integrated 11519 GB local SSD storage volume, supported by a 16 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance does not feature dedicated GPU accelerators. With its large bundled storage footprint and high-density memory, this server delivers efficient disk and processing capability without relying on remote network volumes. The combination of high core counts, substantial RAM, and extensive local disk space makes it well-suited for high-throughput transactional databases, large-scale distributed data stores, and real-time analytical processing.
